verdicts.reason: Both put '$199' above 'New York' and leave 'from' hanging after the city, so the copy now reads '$199 New York from'. A's Meridian logo is shrunk to an illegible speck under the text block, which wrecks the brand. Its suitcase also fills the full height with almost no top or bottom margin, and its 'Book' button is small. B's logo is still undersized, and it is parked at an arbitrary spot near the suitcase's bottom-right instead of on the text axis. But B's logo is readable, and its CTA is a little more substantial, so B is the less broken of the two.
